name: – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: Resolution on the cases of unjustly imprisoned Uyghurs in China, notably Ilham Tohti and Gulshan Abbas
part_text:
The European Parliament calls on China to release Ilham Tohti, a Uyghur economist and Sakharov Prize winner jailed for life in 2014, and Gulshan Abbas, who went missing in 2018 and was reportedly sentenced to 20 years in a secret trial. It also asks China to free all arbitrarily detained activists, stop repression in Xinjiang, Tibet and Hong Kong, and stop harassing detainees' families. The text is an opinion; it does not change any law.

- Nothing changes in law; Parliament only states demands to China.
- It concerns imprisoned Uyghurs, activists and their families in China.
- Parliament sends the text to the EU Council, Commission and China; no action is binding.
